body.x: Business Development Associate (Business Development Department) [based in Seoul]

We are seeking a Business Development Associate for a 2-year-regular position to work within Business Development Department at the International Vaccine Institute in Seoul, Korea. (Duty station: Seoul, Korea)

The incumbent works to improve IVI’s market position by identifying and progressing potential business opportunities that are aligned with the mission of IVI. This person is responsible for the smooth coordination of business development activities across different units and departments in support of business development director. This person will also provide support in developing and managing appropriate documents and materials to support internal and external communications for business development.
1. Coordinate activities and communication required for business development with internal and external stakeholders
Develop cooperation opportunities with internal and external stakeholders; coordinate tasks and activities
Provide support in regular and ad-hoc business development meetings
Coordinate incoming visits in relation to business development
Manage data in the New Initiatives site and Business development site in the IVI intranet and provide archive site to the initiative champions as required
Ensure the timeliness and quality of all deliverables for external events (leaflets, videos, booth design, etc.)
Measure and report performance of all business development activities, assessing performance against goals, costs per outcome and insights that can be applied to future programming
2. Provide insight and analysis in business development field
Provide research and analysis to internal BD partners for new initiatives and opportunities
Analyse financial and legal implications of new opportunities, initiatives and organizational strategy
Provide support in tracking, updating, prioritizing, following up and close (as necessary) the initiatives and opportunities
Provide technical support and inputs in assisting communications for business development
Create, edit and manage documents needed for business development
Archive related information and documents in structured way
Provide support to business development director and BD partners in relation to new initiatives and organizational strategy
Support the work of developing annual business development budget, working with inputs from all reported spending
A Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in science related, business related field

Six years’ experience with undergraduate degree or four years’ experience with a master’s degree in related field: science, business development, or product/project management. Or four years of successful experience in donor organization managing execution of funds within project guidelines
Excellent skills in MS word, PowerPoint and Excel
Excellent communication skills in dealing with senior external contacts
Strong organizational skills; able to juggle multiple priorities.
Excellent inter-personal communication skills; professional presence.
Program/Project management skills are plus (including MS Project skill)
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
